findings: CI-F3: at 21:47Z the stop hook forced a push of the docs-only commit, cancelling Preflight on 76d88cd mid-run (offline-factory, offline-contract-tests and frozen-v4 had already passed there). The docs-only head (identical application code) became the final candidate.

CI-F2: the session stop hook requires every commit to be pushed before the coordinator waits, so batching pushes is not possible while waiting on agents; each push re-triggers both PR workflows and cancels Preflight on the superseded head.

CI-F1 (agent coordination / CI waste): four pushes within 4 minutes while the PR was open cancelled three Preflight runs before they finished. From 21:41Z the coordinator commits locally and pushes only the final candidate.

CI-F4: required-CI latency. The final candidate's verdict was not available 46 min after the push, because one adversarial shard timed out installing browsers from a slow apt mirror. Runner-minutes for the final Preflight run are about 9 jobs; the shard alone used 45.3 min (measured from job timestamps).

jobs.r10-adversarial-cases (1): CANCELLED by job timeout 22:44:38-23:29:58 in 'playwright install --with-deps' (apt); no test ran

postCutoff.acrossBothFinalRuns: every adversarial shard passed at least once on identical application code (shard 0 on 144c4ad, shard 1 on 5151cdf, shard 2 on both); each failure is a different shard killed by the 45-min job timeout during browser/apt setup
postCutoff.repositoryWide: Preflight runs in the same window on other branches were also cancelled after long runs: main push run 42119003736 (22:09-23:20), PR #143 and PR #145 runs; main run 42120987468 succeeded
postCutoff.verdict: Required CI NOT GREEN on the final candidate. Cause judged environmental (runner setup) and not this PR's; no fix exists in the repository; the single allowed re-run was used. Contract groups stay INTEGRATION_READY, not VERIFIED.
postCutoff.proposedFix: Pre-provision Playwright browsers and OS dependencies (cached runner image or actions/cache of ~/.cache/ms-playwright plus apt archives), or give the install step its own short timeout with a retry, so a slow mirror fails fast instead of consuming the 45-min job budget. Not applied: .github/ is outside this experiment's scope.
